subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app performs avoidable idle polling and animation wakeups

question: Should maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100463 as the fix for this macOS idle polling issue now, or require one more signed macOS connected-state refresh proof first?
rationale: The issue is source-reproducible and paired with a protected, open closing PR; the remaining choice is maintainer acceptance of the PR's disclosed proof gap versus asking for one more live connected-state run.

options.title: Land after maintainer review
options.body: Accept the PR's signed idle sample, focused tests, and Testbox evidence as enough to close the issue when the PR merges.

options.title: Request connected-state proof
options.body: Ask for one additional signed macOS run that demonstrates registration refresh while connected before merging the linked PR.

recommendation.title: Land after maintainer review
recommendation.body: Accept the PR's signed idle sample, focused tests, and Testbox evidence as enough to close the issue when the PR merges.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee and author of the linked fix PR for the macOS paths involved.
